rawText:
Your Brain Rot Score sits at a terrifying 70, a “Terminal” badge you’ve earned by liking 239 videos in the past seven days. You’re pumping out 30 likes a day while the content you adore barely reaches two minutes, and the longest you ever tolerated was a 25‑minute “debunking the biggest lie.” That’s the intellectual equivalent of sprinting on a treadmill that never leaves the room.

Your library reads like a broken record: 221 Shorts from Shorts Gremlin, 44 rage‑bait clips, a measly four news pieces. You hoard a “Watch Later” pile of 30 videos you’ll never watch, and your playlists are titled “drama to watch later” and “reaction deep cuts” – all of which you’ll ignore while you loop “only on loop” ad infinitum. Zero self‑improvement likes prove you’ve perfected the art of doing nothing.

You’re a night‑owl with 151 likes logged between midnight and five a.m., hitting binge peaks of 41 likes on a single day. Your “Lurker index” of 0.242 shows you’re more a spectator than a subscriber, forever stuck in the glow of endless short loops. The only thing you’ve ever committed to is the habit of scrolling until the sun rises.

RedFlag: 239 likes in a week while your brain rots at 70/100.  
RedFlag: 92% of your likes are Shorts, proof you can’t sit through a full thought.  
RedFlag: 30 likes per day and you still binge on #shorts satisfying loop.  
RedFlag: 151 midnight likes show you love procrastinating at 3 am.  
RedFlag: 0 self‑improvement likes prove you’ve mastered the art of doing nothing.

Shorts Gremlin fuels your addiction to endless loops.  
Drama Daily feeds your appetite for cheap outrage.

You exhibit chronic dopamine‑chasing behavior, an inability to sustain attention beyond a few seconds, and a pathological need for instant gratification. Your mental diet consists solely of superficial stimuli, leaving no room for growth or depth.

If your brain were a garden, would you even recognize the weeds you’re watering?

“Your life is a loop of Shorts; you’re the human version of a buffering icon.”
